title: Semidefinite Programming for Quantum Channel Learning
abstract: arXiv:2601.12502v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The problem of reconstructing a quantum channel from a sample of classical data is considered. When the total fidelity can be represented as a ratio of two quadratic forms (e.g., in the case of mapping a mixed state to a pure state, projective operators, unitary learning, and others), Semidefinite Programming (SDP) can be applied to solve the fidelity optimization problem with respect to the Choi matrix. A remarkable feature of SDP is that the optimization is convex, which allows the problem to be efficiently solved by a variety of numerical algorithms. We have tested several commercially available SDP solvers, all of which allowed for the reconstruction of quantum channels of different forms. A notable feature is that the Kraus rank of the obtained quantum channel typically comprises less than a few percent of its maximal possible value. translated_title: 用于量子信道学习的半定规划
translated_abstract: 本文考虑从经典数据样本重建量子信道的问题。当总保真度可以表示为两个二次型之比时（例如，在将混合态映射到纯态、投影算符、幺正学习等情况下），可以应用半定规划（SDP）来求解关于Choi矩阵的保真度优化问题。SDP的一个显著特点是优化问题是凸的，这使得该问题可以通过多种数值算法高效求解。我们测试了多个商业可用的SDP求解器，所有求解器都能够重建不同形式的量子信道。一个值得注意的特点是，所获得的量子信道的Kraus秩通常仅占其最大可能值的百分之几，这表明具有相对较小Kraus秩的量子信道通常足以描述（该信道）。
tldr: 本文提出将量子信道重建问题建模为关于Choi矩阵的半定规划（SDP）凸优化问题，从而可高效求解，并发现所得量子信道的Kraus秩通常远低于其最大可能值，说明低Kraus秩信道即可充分描述量子信道。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates quantum channel reconstruction as a convex Semidefinite Programming (SDP) problem over the Choi matrix, enabling efficient solving, and finds that the resulting channels typically have Kraus ranks only a few percent of the maximum, suggesting low-rank channels suffice for quantum channel description.
